prompt:
You are the fresh same-family reviewer required by the novelty-check skill. Perform a bounded critical review of the proposed research direction, not a new implementation. No file edits or experiments. Use xhigh reasoning; independently inspect the named local reports and primary sources as needed. Do not spawn more agents. Return concise Chinese conclusions (700-1100 Chinese characters if possible), closest prior work, defensible delta, practical priority, and one falsification test. Do not call a broad combination novel just because we have not found an exact paper.

User question: In our current project is the goal only pre/post event images -> building damage plus estimated exposure? How innovative is it, and what innovative methods could improve Stage2a's poor LA generalization?

Current code/report evidence:
- Project /Users/zhou/Documents/GitHub/cybertraining-team4, branch stage2a-la-v3-results with unrelated dirty files. No edits authorized for this review.
- pipeline/README.md: SAM3 footprints, prefire Stage2a building-use/exposure proxy, Siamese ConvNeXt pre/post damage, multi-date outputs.
- handoff/stage2a_la/RUN.md: native3, RGB+mask+geometry incl physical area derived from georeferenced imagery, training Census/assessor priors, inference does not need target assessor/Census. Exposure is estimated proxy including commercial; not observed residents/occupancy.
- handoff/stage2a_la/analysis/20261030_hard_ablation/REPORT.md: latest experimental C ensemble macroF1 .610370, multifamily P .166667/R .214286/F1 .1875; 3 TP,15 FP, same11 FN. Compared augmentation A .590907, 3TP19FP;45 positives (23 fourplex)+6 negatives changed imagery to NAIP0.6m upsampled .305m. Seed directions inconsistent. No production promotion.
- analysis/20261030_multifamily_audit/REPORT.md: 9/11 misses fourplex, area155-473m2 vs true-positive639-2551; 7x7 feature mask median2.68 cells vs6.30; no systematic blank/cutoff; high-confidence wrong. These support a scale hypothesis, not proof. Parcel labels aren't building gold. New supplements don't prove label attribution causes these eleven misses.
- analysis/20261029_la_adaptation/REPORT.md: same-data DINO .5724 vs CNN .5716, no advantage.
- Multi-city DINO with near+wide and five-use/two-role already exists: analysis/20261028_multicity_transfer/REPORT.md, improved weak NYC-only model but not better than current CNN and no LA role truth. Don't propose generic role head/dual view as untried or novel.
- Existing exposure already uses SOFT type probabilities in residual HGB; repaired spatial OOF on Harris improves proxy logMAE .212750 -> .153028 but multifamily RMSE worsens24.06->26.76 and target encodes type/area rules. New CNN changes haven't revalidated population head.

Candidate advice to scrutinize:
A. Frame goal as image-driven inference (with georeference, resolution, learned priors), building damage probability + potential exposure, not image-only measured population or casualties. Damage-weighted potential exposure is meaningful but multiplication alone is not novel.
B. Immediate small experiment: hold latest CNN/training data/splits constant; compare original fixed window vs adaptive full-roof near view; then separately add target/context representations, with existing near/wide implementations reused. Only if helpful add intermediate spatial-feature pooling. Known engineering baseline, NOT central novelty. New held-out spatial region with more verified4-8unit buildings; LA3332 is development regression.
C. Main candidate research delta: train-time parcel-to-building dwelling-unit attribution with independently verified building use/role anchors, predicting building-level unit/capacity distribution from preimage at inference. Only verified complete residential parcels have total-unit sum supervision; no target assessor/POI/streetview at inference. Parcel4units may mean (4,0) or (2,2), so neither label copying nor standard positive-bag MIL is valid. Auxiliary structures need verified inhabitation labels; do not force all auxiliary=0. Need anchors because aggregate sum alone doesn't identify assignment. Compare supervised clean-only/mask-ambiguous, naive copied labels, and basic aggregate-count loss before any fancy model. Hypothesis: unlock reliable low-rise training diversity and reduce duplicate assignment and exposure errors, not promise resolve visually unobservable uses.
D. Keep exposure utility as final endpoint: independent unit/occupancy or held-out fine-resolution population references, compare area-only, existing soft-type HGB, direct image->exposure regression, and structured unit approach; damage estimates fixed for first comparison. Interval/uncertainty propagation by itself not new. New target-city Census calibration must be a separate assisted setting, never called image-only.

Relevant primary literature found by parent (read depths explicitly limited):
1. Application of MambaBDA for Building Damage Assessment in the 2025 Los Angeles Wildfire, Buildings2025, https://doi.org/10.3390/buildings15224019 : publisher-indexed abstract/method shows pre/post + GHSL population exposure in Altadena; direct-page429, not fullpaper-read.
2. NBDANet storm damage plus GHSL exposure, npj Natural Hazards2026 https://www.nature.com/articles/s44304-026-00255-y : publisher-indexed abstract only.
3. POPCORN RSE2024, https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.14006 and https://popcorn-population.github.io/ : builtup times occupancy, weak coarse-Census supervision; inference images possible after training.
4. POMELO SciRep2022/23 https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.04039 : coarse counts + open geodata, count-free cross-country transfer exists.
5. LandScan mosaic, SciRep2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12738844/ : primary methods read; building use/floors/occupancy distributions, explicit uncertainty propagation and risk-weighted exposure decisions already exist.
6. Building-Level Population Estimation Method Using a Bayesian-Informed Hierarchical Learning Model, IJGI2026, https://www.mdpi.com/2220-9964/15/6/264 : indexed publisher method says building-feature regression priors and 3-level population disaggregation with Census constraints; direct-page429, details require verification.
7. BuildingSense ESSD2026 https://essd.copernicus.org/articles/18/2609/2026/ : roof plus60.96m context, streetview, POIs, 34,458 NYC samples26 classes, source methods read.
8. Liang etal Heterogeneous GNN building attributes ISPRS2026 https://ual.sg/publication/2026-ijprs-gnn/2026-ijprs-gnn.pdf : DINOv3+urban graphs+streetview, random60/20/20 splits, not unseen city.
9. Geographic transferability of building function models JSTARS2026 https://elib.dlr.de/227125/ : six countries, global data+footprint improve transfer, binary residential/nonresidential.
10. Enhancing Geo-Transferability in Building Function Classification Through Similar Place Knowledge Retrieval TGRS2026 https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2026.3659015 : nine-city transfer uses imagery,POI,footprints, knowledge retrieval; abstract only.
11. Standard count-level weak supervision and attention MIL already established; their use alone is not novel.

Questions: Is C a defensible added contribution worth a small pilot, and exactly which part is thin? Is there a stronger simpler path within image-only inference? Are we overstating any cause or ignoring that previous role/dualview models already ran? Do not recommend adding inference modalities as if preserving image-only scope.

=== NOVELTY VERDICT LIMITS (these bound how you judge, never how widely you search) ===
Search exhaustively; judge calibrated. Two failures waste months equally:
passing an idea a published paper already contains, and killing a viable idea
because the territory has neighbors.
1. Proximity is information, not a verdict. Someone working nearby goes in the
   report; it is not by itself a reason to reject.
2. ABANDON has exactly one qualification: a specific published paper already
   contains this result — name that paper. No named paper, no ABANDON.
3. Crowded-but-deltaed is PROCEED: state the delta in one sentence a reviewer
   could verify. Thin or contested delta is PROCEED WITH CAUTION — say what
   would make it carry, not why it should die. CAUTION is not a safe middle:
   if you cannot name the specific thing that makes the delta thin, the
   verdict is PROCEED.
4. Concurrent or competing work is not a veto. That is a race — report it and
   let the user decide whether to run it.
5. A direct attack on a central problem is legitimate novelty when nobody has
   executed it well. "This area is hot" does not mean "this area is taken."
6. This check is an early gate, never the last one — more triage, pilots, or
   external review still stand between any idea and a paper, whatever order
   this run uses. A wrongly passed idea dies cheaply at one of them; a wrongly
   killed idea is never seen again. When torn between two verdicts, choose the
   more permissive one.
Say plainly when an idea clears the check. Do not manufacture overlap.
